This repository uses UV for all Python operations. Never use `python -m`, `pip install`, or `python script.py` directly.
```sh
uv run pytest
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/
uv pip install package
uv run python script.py
```

**v4.1.9:** Python package with slash commands; `.claude-plugin/` and the TypeScript plugin system do not exist (planned for v5.0; issue #419). Current layout: `settings.json`, `commands/` (installed via `superclaude install`), `src/superclaude/` (pytest plugin/CLI; `pm_agent/`, `execution/`, `cli/`), `tests/`, `scripts/`. `plugins/superclaude/` is future source, NOT ACTIVE. See `PLANNING.md` (architecture/absolute rules), `TASK.md`, `KNOWLEDGE.md`, `docs/user-guide/`, `docs/developer-guide/`, `docs/reference/`.

Commands install to `~/.claude/commands/`; available: `/pm`, `/research`, `/index-repo` and others. Install: `pipx install superclaude && superclaude install`. Package: `superclaude`; hatchling (PEP 517); CLI `superclaude`; pytest plugin auto-loaded as `superclaude`, registered in `pyproject.toml`.

Plugin features unavailable in v4.1.9: `.claude-plugin/` auto-detection, `/plugin marketplace add`, `/plugin install superclaude`, `make build-plugin`, project-local plugin detection, marketplace distribution, TypeScript plugins. Planned v5.0; see `docs/plugin-reorg.md`, `docs/next-refactor-plan.md`, issue #419. `make build-plugin` and `make sync-plugin-repo` are listed commands but not functional.

**Commands**
```sh
make dev
make verify
make test
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/ -v
uv run pytest tests/test_file.py -v
uv run pytest -m confidence_check
uv run pytest --cov=superclaude
make lint
make format
make doctor
make build-plugin
make sync-plugin-repo
make clean
```

Fixtures: `confidence_checker`, `self_check_protocol`, `reflexion_pattern`, `token_budget`, `pm_context`. Unit/integration markers: `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.unit`, `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.integration`; custom: `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.confidence_check`, `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.self_check`, `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.reflexion`. Also `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.complexity("medium")` (simple 200, medium 1000, complex 2500).

ConfidenceChecker (`src/superclaude/pm_agent/confidence.py`): pre-execution; ≥90% proceed, 70–89% present alternatives, <70% ask questions. SelfCheckProtocol (`self_check.py`): post-implementation, evidence-based; no speculation—verify with tests/docs. ReflexionPattern (`reflexion.py`): error learning/cross-session matching. Parallel execution (`src/superclaude/execution/parallel.py`): Wave → Checkpoint → Wave; analyze dependencies; read/edit files in parallel.

Branches: `master` production ← `integration` testing ← `feature/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`. Create from integration: `git checkout -b feature/your-feature`; test `uv run pytest`; commit `git commit -m "feat: description"` (conventional commits); merge to integration, validate, then master. Current branch: session-start git status.

**CRITICAL**: When running multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel, use `git worktree` to avoid conflicts.
```sh
cd ~/github/SuperClaude_Framework
git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration integration
git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-feature feature/pm-agent
git worktree remove ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration
```
Use separate worktrees/sessions; avoid branch-switching conflicts and state corruption.

**Never guess** - verify with official docs (Context7 MCP, WebFetch, WebSearch) before implementation.
Check confidence BEFORE starting: ≥90% proceed, 70-89% present alternatives, <70% ask questions.
Use Wave → Checkpoint → Wave pattern. Budgets: simple 200, medium 1,000, complex 2,500 tokens. Prefer MCP tools over speculation for documentation/research. MCPs: Tavily (search), Context7 (official docs), Sequential (reasoning), Serena (session persistence), Mindbase (cross-session learning); optional Playwright, Magic, Chrome DevTools. Uses airis-mcp-gateway.
